typography.instructions: Use tracking-tight for large headings (H1/H2). Body text must be highly legible. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard defaults for headings. Use text-[#2A2521] for primary text.

visual enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Use thin 1px borders (border-black/10) to define edges instead of heavy drop shadows. Focus rings should be solid and match brand colors.
visual enhancers.border_radius: Soft rounded corners: 12px or 16px for cards (rounded-xl/rounded-2xl), 9999px for primary action buttons (rounded-full).
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle paper-like warmth achieved through the #FBF7F1 background. Keep the UI 'Clay & Crisp'.

component name.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Large touch targets (min-h-[56px]) for mobile public pages. Distinct color blocking: Terracotta for Call, Teal for WhatsApp.
component name.cards: White background (#FFFFFF), thin border, no shadow. Internal padding must be generous (p-6 or p-8).
component name.inputs: 14px rounded (rounded-xl), 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-[#B5502F] (Terracotta) and border-transparent.
component name.badges: Small pill-shaped tags for vehicle/business type with soft background colors (e.g., bg-[#0F6E56]/10 text-[#0F6E56]).

grids.admin_dashboard: Bento Grid protocol. Wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8). Use a 3-column layout for top stat cards, and a robust data table/grid for the tag inventory.
grids.rules: Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly if not needed. Allow breathing room. Grid items MUST be direct children.

layouts.public_pages: Mobile-first single column. Centered max-w-md container on desktop to simulate mobile view. Generous vertical spacing.
layouts.claim_form: Stacked form fields, left-aligned labels. Bilingual helper text directly under labels.
layouts.contact_page: Dark header block for the tag type label, followed by a large claimed name. Big, easily tappable contact buttons.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions only. Hover states on buttons (translate-y-[-2px] with subtle shadow). Entrance staggered fade-in for admin grid items. No aggressive animations.
motion.transitions: Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) rather than transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over brand colors meets WCAG AA standards. Use white text on Terracotta and Teal buttons.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have clear focus-visible rings.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'data-testid="claim-submit-button"').

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, modern standard icons (Phone, MessageCircle, Shield, Printer, Download).

image urls.description: Peaceful sunrise view in Northeast India. Use as an optional subtle background or side-panel image for the Admin Login desktop page with a white/50 backdrop-blur overlay.

3d libraries.usage: Not required. Focus on fast, lightweight 2D performance for mobile web.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React (.js) and Tailwind CSS.
Apply the Light theme exclusively, adhering to the #FBF7F1 background and #2A2521 text.
Ensure public pages (/p/:tag_id) are heavily optimized for mobile viewing, with a max-width container on desktop.
Admin dashboard must contain 3 stat cards, a batch QR generation input/button, a tag inventory grid, and a ZIP download button.
Public claim form MUST have bilingual text (English + Bengali) for key instructions and labels.
The Contact page must visually distinguish 'Call' (Terracotta color) and 'WhatsApp' (Teal color) buttons.
Create Shadcn-style components manually using pure Tailwind and HTML elements since this is a custom creative layout.
Remember to add 'data-testid' to every interactive element for testing purposes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file).
Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖, 💡) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Always use modern button styles with proper touch targets and interaction animations.
